entries.title: First clean public build
items: Main menu rebuilt with clearer Free, Premium and Roadmap sections.
EMC Store added with offer cards, store links and automatic in-game name login.
EarthMC Premium and EMCE Premium are now shown as separate status cards.
Hopper Filter builder added for saving, validating and copying Hopplet scripts.
Advertising added as an EMCE Premium tool for preparing /trade messages.
Premium cards now show their locked or active state directly in the menu.
Weather, vote, waypoint and profile tools were cleaned up into the new UI style.
mcMMO, Towny and unfinished Extras cards are now grouped into the roadmap until ready.
